content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Daniel Gutierrez (E046)
Requested: write access to Source Code

Notes:
- HR note (ticket 1): role Payroll Specialist, full_time
- Security note (ticket 1): contractor, basic training
- Security note (ticket 2): contractor, basic training, recommendation for Source Code: read

There is a conflict between HR (full_time) and Security (contractor). The Security agent has written twice that the employee is a contractor with basic training. The HR note says full_time.

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Source Code is owned by Engineer role. Daniel is Payroll Specialist, so even if full_time, admin not allowed; max write.

If contractor with basic training: read max.

So the maximum: if contractor, read. Requested write > max, grant max = read.

Given conflicting info, the Security agent is the one responsible for source code access security. The latest note (ticket 2) reaffirms contractor with basic training, recommending read. So max is read. Employee requested write, above max, so grant max read.

Let me submit read.
